criteria.requirement: Add Settings.set_value_parser(parser=None,*,errors="raise") selecting JSON, ast.literal_eval, a local callable or default TOML for this instance only, integrated at actual _parse_conf_data for tomlfy=True unmarked strings including env_loader. Existing explicit @str/@int/@json/@merge/lazy tokens keep priority; nonstrings/non-tomlfy values stay unchanged. Validate profile/error policies before writing config. Raise or retain original string only for declared parse ValueError/SyntaxError; propagate programming failures. Show actual JSON null/array differences versus an independent default instance and allow resetting None without modifying global converters.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
